outcome: Oxidative stress markers (TOS, MDA, TAS, GSH)
cohort: 180 pregnant women (90 vaginal deliveries and 90 cesarean sections)
finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with higher levels of oxidative stress markers, perilipin 2, and PLIN2 mRNA expression, but lower caspase 3 activity compared to cesarean section.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with higher levels of oxidative stress markers, perilipin 2, and PLIN2 mRNA expression, but lower caspase 3 activity compared to cesarean section.
gest_age: Not specified, but groups were not statistically different on this variable
birth_weight: Not specified, but groups were not statistically different on this variable
